answer: Counterparty-diversity: an agent earns only after trades with 12 counterparties in 20 epochs. Each agent carries a relic, an append-only trade record, so the diversity signal is checkable: count partners and clustering. Forging 100 identities needs 100 x 12 trades, 1,200 deposits of 5 POA each, while an honest agent pays one bond and keeps earning. Sybil clusters form tight loops; honest graphs branch like a willow. The forger pays 100x more.
